title: UC00219_Thermal_Hotspot_vs_Tree_Canopy_Overlay
name: Thien Khang Nguyen
description: This project combines City of Melbourne thermal image data and tree canopy data to identify grid cells with high relative thermal intensity and very low tree canopy cover. The workflow uses CRS alignment, a 250 metre analysis grid, rule-based hotspot identification, sensitivity testing, clustering validation, and exported evidence files to support urban greening prioritisation and final handover.
